machinelearning.name: Machine Learning: What Changes, and Why?
machinelearning.truth: A change in appearance is not yet evidence of learning. Follow what changes, what measures it and what stays fixed.
machinelearning.qfep_connection: Within Ada Research, learning opens questions about what a model preserves and excludes. These are project interpretations; learning is not universally gradient descent, and data variability is not identical to thermodynamic entropy.
machinelearning.description: Eight encounters distinguish environmental selection, loss, clustering, learned weights, image filtering, diagrams of memory and adversarial learning, and anomaly rules. Follow each operation before interpreting what its result means.
learning_objectives: Identify selection conditions without requiring an explicit leaderboard
Compare three loss rules on controlled observations and repeatable starts
Compare four cluster centres on three blobs, rings and an unclustered sample
Distinguish transient activation, learned parameters and evidence of generalisation
Separate computed edge evidence from supplied recognition labels
Read memory and adversarial-learning diagrams without mistaking animation for trained state
Relate anomaly scores to a threshold and reference population
content: ML_Evolution: Selection without a leaderboard - environmental conditions still select
ML_Gradient_Landscape: Three judgements of the same observations - compare losses and repeat the start
ML_Classification: A boundary that moves with its centre - compare fixed K across blobs, rings and a block
ML_Neural_Networks: What changes when a network learns - distinguish activations, parameters and generalisation
ML_Perception: An edge is not yet an object - distinguish a computed response from a supplied label
ML_Sequence_Memory: What should survive the next input - trace a gate diagram and its missing experiment
ML_Generative: Learning from an opponent’s response - trace an animated diagram without claiming trained models
ML_Synthesis: The point outside the rule - ask what an anomaly flag can establish
